## Triage: first touch → `domain:server` · p2 · 2026-11-15T22:49Z

⛔ Not a claim.

HotCRM measured on 18.5.0 that a CSV export has no UTF-8 byte-order mark, so Excel (Windows and Mac) opens Chinese, or any non-ASCII, columns as garbled text. Every Chinese customer who exports a list to Excel hits it, so **p2**. The fix is to write the BOM on CSV export.
